title: Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents
author: Kahlie Wray
content:
Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not
only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens. Since the
start of this Trump administration, we've watched those warnings come true.

So we have once again done what the government won’t: We have tallied and
cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining
a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from
Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.

[Read our earlier reporting on U.S. citizens being
detained.](https://projects.propublica.org/american-citizens-detained-dhs-
civil-rights/)

We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media,
and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it.
We asked the Department of Homeland Security about each incident, and we
searched for any federal criminal charges that were brought in relation to
each incident. (DHS has repeatedly said it is not arresting U.S. citizens.)

Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost
certainly an undercount. Below, we're showing you every case we found — the
reality that the administration denies — along with the receipts. Read more
about [how we reported this
project.](https://projects.propublica.org/american-citizens-detained-dhs-
civil-rights/list/#footer)

The post [Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration
Agents](https://projects.propublica.org/american-citizens-detained-dhs-civil-
rights/list) appeared first on [ProPublica](https://www.propublica.org).
